comments: REPLACE_WITH_ANY_OVERALL_COMMENT. Scoped correction only, superseding APR-AD-EC-12000-003 for TS-EC-12000-011 through -015: the v3 approval's CLEANUP mechanism (Print -> Verify Paper Out modal -> select-all -> Verify -> confirm alert, an irreversible action that permanently deletes source documents from the vault) was never actually exercised before being approved. Live PLAYWRIGHT_VALIDATION against qa5 on 2026-09-16 shows the eoRequestExport-created batch lands in Work Queue status Submitted / next-step Approval (the same state TS-EC-12000-003's UI-submitted batches reach), not Authorized/Verification, so the Verify flow does not apply. The corrected mechanism is the existing reversible Cancel Request flow (WorkQueueComponent.cancelApprovalItem(): hover row -> .batch-dropdown-action -> .cancelPaperOut -> confirm Cancel Request), confirmed live by cancelling a real test batch (DEBUG-1789499020791) end to end. No other part of the v3 approval (dictated eoRequestExport endpoint, scaffoldingOnly contract, dynamic Collection selection) changes.
